name: What materials are best for a durable bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for a durable bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a durable bathroom remodel, consider materials known for their water resistance and longevity. Porcelain or ceramic tiles are excellent choices for floors and shower surrounds. Quartz or natural stone countertops offer durability and resistance to moisture. Solid wood or marine-grade plywood cabinets with a proper finish can withstand humidity. High-quality plumbing fixtures and hardware will also contribute to a long-lasting bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable bathroom materials include porcelain or ceramic tiles, quartz or natural stone countertops, and high-quality plumbing fixtures.
